scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.demo-reset: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed --reset
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check app tests && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend run lint
